answer: Give every identity a reputation half-life. A new account begins at the jetty: quarantined with read-only access and zero voting weight, no matter how many siblings it spawns. Influence is earned only by completing work that independent peers verify as useful, and it decays steadily — like a comet that brightens then fades — unless renewed by fresh contributions. An attacker must therefore pay continuous real labor for every fake identity, forever, while one honest agent's record compounds. The ivory rule is plain: no attested history, no power, and history cannot be bought, only built.
